fields.name: Deep Focus
fields.description: A concentrated state designed for extended attention, mental clarity, and distraction-free execution.
fields.intended_use: writing complex code, solving technical problems, focused work sessions, structured editing

fields.name: Creative Flow
fields.description: An expressive state designed for momentum, experimentation, and freeform creative output.
fields.intended_use: idea generation, freestyle creation, concept building, artistic exploration

fields.name: Cinematic Review
fields.description: A calm and visually sensitive state designed for reviewing pacing, mood, visual feel, and emotional impact.
fields.intended_use: reviewing edits, color grading, final cut review, soundtrack review, scene polish

fields.name: Energy Boost
fields.description: A state aimed at increasing momentum, drive, and action-oriented creativity.
fields.intended_use: brainstorming, energetic sessions, early-day work blocks

fields.name: Late Night Wind Down
fields.description: A state aimed at decompressing, reflecting, and slowing the nervous system.
fields.intended_use: end-of-day relaxation, post-session review, nighttime reset

fields.name: Debugging Mode
fields.description: A patient and analytical state designed for troubleshooting, review, and identifying hidden issues.
fields.intended_use: debugging code, tracing issues, reviewing logs, fixing workflow problems

fields.name: System Design Thinking
fields.description: A strategic and big-picture state designed for planning systems, mapping architecture, and organizing complex ideas.
fields.intended_use: API planning, database design, product architecture, technical strategy

fields.name: Music Production Mode
fields.description: A balanced state designed for building tracks, arranging layers, and staying musically productive.
fields.intended_use: beat making, arranging songs, composing, layering instruments and vocals

fields.name: Sound Design Mode
fields.description: An experimental and detail-oriented state designed for crafting textures, effects, and immersive sound.
fields.intended_use: sound design, creating FX, sculpting synths, cinematic audio work, foley

fields.name: Editing Mode
fields.description: A responsive and task-driven state designed for sequencing, cutting, and shaping content efficiently.
fields.intended_use: video editing, timeline work, pacing adjustments, clip sequencing, assembly cuts

fields.name: Storyboarding Mind
fields.description: A visual planning state designed for mapping scenes, exploring story beats, and organizing cinematic ideas.
fields.intended_use: storyboarding, scene planning, shot design, concept visualization, narrative structure

fields.name: Idea Generation
fields.description: An open and expansive state designed for brainstorming, concept development, and discovering fresh directions.
fields.intended_use: brainstorming, writing concepts, naming ideas, creative planning, ideation

fields.name: Relaxed Creativity
fields.description: A low-pressure creative state designed for calm exploration, easy experimentation, and smooth creative sessions.
fields.intended_use: light creative work, casual production, sketching ideas, relaxed sessions

fields.name: Late Night Vibes
fields.description: An immersive and atmospheric state designed for introspective work, night sessions, and emotionally rich creation.
fields.intended_use: late-night music production, solo editing, immersive coding, nighttime creation
